python3 - <<'EOF'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

content = open('project_kickoff.ics').read()
assert content.count('BEGIN:VEVENT') == content.count('END:VEVENT') == 1
assert content.count('BEGIN:VCALENDAR') == content.count('END:VCALENDAR') == 1
assert content.count('BEGIN:VALARM') == content.count('END:VALARM') == 1

m = re.search(r'DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:(\d{8}T\d{6})', content)
start = datetime.strptime(m.group(1), '%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')
m = re.search(r'DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:(\d{8}T\d{6})', content)
end = datetime.strptime(m.group(1), '%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')
assert start.weekday() == 0, "not a Monday"
assert end - start == timedelta(hours=2), "duration not 2h"
assert 'SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting' in content
assert re.search(r'UID:.+@calendar', content)
print("Valid: Monday", start.date(), start.strftime('%H:%M'), "-", end.strftime('%H:%M'), "(Asia/Shanghai), 2 hours")
EOF
